en.title: PowerWash Simulator 2 Tackles Star Wars' Filth This Summer
en.summary: Prepare to blast away the grime of a galaxy far, far away. PowerWash Simulator 2 is officially expanding its cleaning roster with a brand-new Star Wars pack.
en.body:
The galaxy is about to get a whole lot cleaner. FuturLab, in collaboration with Lucasfilm Games, has announced the **PowerWash Simulator 2 - Star Wars Pack**, bringing the iconic grime and grit of the original trilogy to players this summer. Revealed at IGN Live 2026, the DLC promises a fresh coat of paint, or rather, a thorough power wash, on some of the most memorable locations and vehicles from a galaxy far, far away.

Players will step into the boots, or rather, the chassis, of a class five labor droid, designated P0-W2. Their mission? To meticulously clean up the mess left behind by smugglers, rebels, and the Empire. The new trailer showcased glimpses of beloved locales such as the moisture-farming haven of **Lars Homestead** on Tatooine and the bustling, shady hub of **Chalmun's Cantina**. Beyond static locations, players will also get their hands dirty with iconic starships and vehicles, including swift **X-Wing fighters**, imposing **AT-AT walkers**, and even the bridge of a colossal **Super Star Destroyer**. The commitment to the original trilogy's aesthetic, known for its realistic, worn-in feel, makes this pack a particularly exciting prospect for long-time fans.

## A Galaxy of Grime Awaits

The appeal of **PowerWash Simulator 2** lies in its serene yet deeply satisfying gameplay loop: identify dirt, apply the right nozzle, and watch the transformation unfold. Introducing the **Star Wars** universe into this formula taps directly into a core element of George Lucas's original vision. Unlike the often pristine sci-fi epics of its time, *Star Wars* embraced a lived-in, dirty aesthetic. From the dust of Tatooine to the scorch marks on a starfighter, the universe has always had its share of grime. This DLC allows players to engage with that detail on an unprecedented level, turning the mundane task of cleaning into an interactive homage to the original trilogy's visual storytelling.

## For the Dedicated Fan

This isn't just about washing; it's about experiencing familiar worlds from a completely new perspective. For fans who have spent decades poring over every detail of the original trilogy, from the scorch marks on a droid to the scuff marks on a starship’s hull, this pack offers a unique form of engagement. The chance to personally restore the pristine condition of iconic vehicles like X-Wings or ensure the bridge of a Super Star Destroyer is spotless before Lord Vader’s arrival adds a layer of playful immersion. It’s a testament to the enduring legacy of *Star Wars* that even its dirt and grime have become iconic elements worthy of a dedicated simulator experience.

## What's Next

The **PowerWash Simulator 2: Star Wars Pack** is scheduled to launch on July 16, 2026, for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, PC, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2. Fans can expect to get their hoses ready for an adventure across the original trilogy's most memorable, and dirtiest, corners.

tr.title: PowerWash Simulator 2, Star Wars'ın Kirliliğini Bu Yaz Cleanleyecek
tr.summary: Galaksi, PowerWash Simulator 2'nin yeni Star Wars paketiyle çok daha temiz olacak. FuturLab ve Lucasfilm Games, bu yaz çıkacak olan PowerWash Simulator 2 - Star Wars Paketi'ni duyurdu.
tr.body:
PowerWash Simulator 2, galaksiyi temizlemenin heyecanını bu yaz Star Wars evrenine taşıyor. FuturLab ve Lucasfilm Games işbirliğiyle geliştirilen **PowerWash Simulator 2 - Star Wars Paketi**, orijinal üçlemenin ikonik mekanlarını ve araçlarını temizlemenin keyfini vaat ediyor. IGN Live 2026'da açıklanan bu DLC, Tatooine'deki **Lars Çiftliği** ve **Chalmun's Cantina** gibi sevilen yerleri temizleme fırsatı sunuyor.

Oyuncular, bir sınıf beş işçi droidi olan P0-W2'nin içine steppederek, kaçakçılar, isyancılar ve İmparatorluk tarafından bırakılan kiri temizleyecekler. Yeni fragman, **X-Wing savaşçıları**, **AT-AT yürüyücüler** ve sogar bir **Süper Yıldız Destroyer**'in köprüsünü temizleme fırsatını gösteriyor. Orijinal üçlemenin gerçekçi, aşınmış hissi, bu paketi uzun süredir fanlar için özellikle heyecan verici kılıyor.

## Bir Galaksi Kiri Bekliyor

**PowerWash Simulator 2**'nin çekiciliği, sakin ancak derinlemesine tatmin edici oyun döngüsünde yatıyor: kiri tanımla, doğru nozulu uygula ve dönüşümü izle. Star Wars evrenini bu formüle dahil etmek, George Lucas'ın orijinal vizyonunun temel bir unsuruna dokunuyor. Diğer çoğu bilim kurgu filminden farklı olarak, *Star Wars* bir yaşlanmış, kirli estetiği benimsemişti. Bu DLC, oyuncuların bu detayla önceden görülmemiş bir şekilde etkileşime girmesine olanak tanıyor ve temizleme görevini orijinal üçlemenin görsel anlatımına bir övgü haline getiriyor.

## Adanmış Fanlar İçin

Bu sadece temizleme değil, tanıdık dünyaları tamamen yeni bir perspektiften deneyimleme fırsatı sunuyor. Orijinal üçlemenin her ayrıntısına yıllarca dikkat etmiş fanlar için, bu paket benzersiz bir etkileşim sunuyor. X-Wing'leri veya bir Süper Yıldız Destroyer'in köprüsünü Lord Vader'ın gelişinden önce mükemmel bir şekilde temizleme şansı, keyifli bir kurgu katmanı ekliyor. Bu, *Star Wars*'ın kalıcı mirasının, even kiri ve tozunun, adanmış bir simulator deneyimi hak ettiği ikonik unsurlar haline geldiğinin bir kanıtı.

## Sonraki Adımlar

**PowerWash Simulator 2: Star Wars Paketi**, 16 Temmuz 2026'da PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, PC, Xbox Series X/S ve Nintendo Switch 2 için çıkacak. Fanlar, orijinal üçlemenin en unutulmaz ve en kirli köşelerini temizlemek için hazırlıklı olmalı.

es.title: PowerWash Simulator 2 se enfrenta a la suciedad de Star Wars este verano
es.summary: Prepárate para eliminar la suciedad de una galaxia lejana. PowerWash Simulator 2 amplía su lista de limpieza con un nuevo paquete de Star Wars. FuturLab, en colaboración con Lucasfilm Games, ha anunciado el paquete que traerá la suciedad y el polvo de la trilogía original a los jugadores este verano.
es.body:
La galaxia está a punto de volverse mucho más limpia. FuturLab, en colaboración con Lucasfilm Games, ha anunciado el **PowerWash Simulator 2 - Paquete de Star Wars**, que traerá la suciedad y el polvo de la trilogía original a los jugadores este verano. Revelado en IGN Live 2026, el DLC promete una capa fresca de pintura, o más bien, un lavado a presión, en algunos de los lugares y vehículos más memorables de una galaxia lejana.

Los jugadores se pondrán en la piel, o más bien, en el chasis, de un droide de trabajo de clase cinco, designado P0-W2. Su misión es limpiar meticulosamente el desastre que han dejado los contrabandistas, los rebeldes y el Imperio. El nuevo tráiler mostró vistas de lugares queridos como el refugio de la granja de humedad de **Lars Homestead** en Tatooine y el bullicioso y sombrío centro de **Chalmun's Cantina**. Más allá de los lugares estáticos, los jugadores también se ensuciarán las manos con naves y vehículos icónicos, incluyendo rápidos **cazas X-Wing**, imponentes **caminares AT-AT** y incluso el puente de un colossal **Super Destructor Estelar**. El compromiso con la estética de la trilogía original, conocida por su sensación realista y desgastada, hace que este paquete sea una perspectiva emocionante para los fanáticos de larga data.

## Una galaxia de suciedad espera

El atractivo de **PowerWash Simulator 2** radica en su bucle de juego sereno y profundamente satisfactorio: identificar la suciedad, aplicar la boquilla adecuada y ver la transformación. Introducir el universo de **Star Wars** en esta fórmula toca directamente un elemento central de la visión original de George Lucas. A diferencia de las epopeyas de ciencia ficción souventemente impecables de su época, *Star Wars* abrazó una estética vivida y sucia. Desde el polvo de Tatooine hasta las marcas de quemadura en un caza estelar, el universo siempre ha tenido su parte de suciedad. Este DLC permite a los jugadores interactuar con ese detalle de una manera sin precedentes, convirtiendo la tarea mundana de limpiar en un homenaje interactivo a la narrativa visual de la trilogía original.

## Para el fanático dedicado

Esto no se trata solo de lavar; se trata de experimentar mundos familiares desde una perspectiva completamente nueva. Para los fanáticos que han pasado décadas estudiando cada detalle de la trilogía original, desde las marcas de quemadura en un droide hasta las marcas de desgaste en el casco de una nave estelar, este paquete ofrece una forma única de compromiso. La oportunidad de restaurar personalmente la condición impecable de vehículos icónicos como los cazas X-Wing o asegurarse de que el puente de un Super Destructor Estelar esté impecable antes de la llegada del señor Vader agrega una capa de inmersión juguetona. Es un testimonio de la legado duradero de *Star Wars* que incluso su suciedad y polvo se han convertido en elementos icónicos dignos de una experiencia de simulador dedicada.

## Próximos pasos

El **PowerWash Simulator 2: Paquete de Star Wars** está programado para lanzarse el 16 de julio de 2026 para PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, PC, Xbox Series X/S y Nintendo Switch 2. Los fanáticos pueden esperar estar listos para una aventura a través de los rincones más memorables y sucios de la trilogía original.

content_raw: At IGN Live Saturday, attendees got a first look at a new trailer for the PowerWash Simulator 2: Star Wars Pack DLC. When George Lucas created Star Wars , one of the things that stood out about it compared to other sci-fi movies of its era was the lived in aesthetic, which included the kind of dirt and grime rarely seen up until that point in a genre that usually went for clean and pristine. But as much as things can be dirty in Star Wars, sometimes you gotta take a look at your filthy Gonk droid and realize it's time to wash that sucker! In this Star Wars take on PowerWash Simulator 2, players will play as a class five labor droid, P0-W2. The new trailer provides more glimpses of the different iconic locations and vehicles featured, all pulled from the original trilogy era that the PowerWash Simulator 2: Star Wars Pack is set in, including the Lars Homestead, Chalmun's Cantina, X-Wing fighters, AT-ATs, and the bridge of a Super Star Destroyer... And trust me, you are gonna want to make that bridge look good before Lord Vader comes back and starts Force choking you. The Star Wars Pack for PowerWash Simulator 2 will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 5 Pro (PS5 Pro), PC, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2 on July 16, 2026. Be sure to keep up with everything going on at IGN Live 2026 . You can check the full schedule to see what else is coming up across games, movies, TV, streaming, and more.
